## FAQ

**How much does a custom website cost for a locksmith business?**
Our setups start from $997, with a monthly fee of $299 that covers hosting, basic local SEO, call-tracking, and maintenance.

**Do I pay before seeing my site?**
No. We build a fully functional demo first. You only pay if you love it. Zero upfront cost or commitment.

**What is yourbusiness.drape.digital?**
It's a private subdomain where we host your demo site. You can browse the full site on any device exactly as it will appear on your final domain.

**How long does a site take?**
Working prototype within 72 hours. Full handover including revisions, domain transfer, and launch usually takes 1–2 weeks.

**What if I don't like the demo?**
You walk away — no cost, no obligation.

**Do you offer Google Ads for locksmiths?**
Yes, in Tier 3. Locksmith clicks run $40–$80, so budget matters — we'll tell you if your area isn't worth it.

**Can you rank me for "locksmith near me"?**
That's a map pack result — it depends on your Google Business Profile, reviews, and proximity. Our Tier 2 builds the location pages and GBP presence that feed that ranking. Takes 4–6 months.
